title: Fix an Agent Stuck in a Tool-Call Loop
summary: An agent's loop-termination check never fires — find and fix the bug keeping it stuck calling the same tool.
description:
## Scenario

An agent occasionally gets stuck calling the same tool with the same arguments over and over — usually because a tool returned an error the model doesn't know how to act on differently. Production has a guard meant to detect this pattern and force the agent to stop, but on-call reports agents burning through their entire step budget instead of tripping the guard early.

## Task

`solution.py` contains `is_stuck_in_loop(action_history: list[str], repeat_threshold: int) -> bool`. It's meant to return `True` when the **most recent** `repeat_threshold` actions in `action_history` are all identical (the agent repeating itself right now) — not when *any* `repeat_threshold`-sized run of identical actions appears anywhere in history. Find the bug and fix it.

## Requirements

- Do not change the function's signature.
- If `len(action_history) < repeat_threshold`, there isn't enough history to judge — return `False`.
- Only the tail of the history matters: old repeated actions earlier in the list must not trigger a false positive if recent actions have moved on.

testCases.name: old repetition does not falsely trigger
